plan.title: Add discovery session button to Tasks view
plan.overview: Add a comment-discussion icon button to the KANBAN TASKS view header that launches /kanban-discover in a terminal. This follows the existing createTask command pattern in extension.ts:285-300 and the view/title menu configuration in package.json:98-109. The button appears before the + button via navigation@0 group ordering.

approach.rationale:
Following existing patterns exactly: - Command registration: package.json contributes.commands with $(icon-name) syntax (line 63-95) - View title menu: contributes.menus.view/title with group: "navigation@N" (line 98-109) - Terminal execution: createFreshTerminal + sendCommand pattern (extension.ts:260-265)
The discovery command is simpler than createTask - no input box needed, just open terminal and run the command directly.

change.old: navigation@1 for createTask, navigation@2 for refresh
change.new: navigation@0 for startDiscovery, navigation@1 for createTask, navigation@2 for refresh

Add after refresh, before createTask: ```json { "command": "kanban.startDiscovery", "title": "Kanban: Start Discovery - Explore questions through Socratic Q&A", "icon": "$(comment-discussion)" }, ```
